notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Start the game and get started!

Go to the mine to start mining.
In the game, you will need to extract resources of three types: stone, coal and iron. 
Buy temporary upgrades in the forge and bar to speed up mining. 

Every 3 hours, with varying probability, you will receive minerals of various types for your collection in the steam inventory!

Join our social networks and participate in tournaments!
[url=https://t.me/gnomich_game]Telegram[/url] and [url=https://discord.com/invite/wBpaTn3ZXd]Discord[/url]

Good luck and good loot!
